7 انبطح It (water) went to the right and left in a place. (AA.) ―
-b2- See also 5. ―
-b3- He became thrown down upon his face: (S, A, K:) or he lay, or lay as though thrown down or extended, upon his face: (Mgh, Msb:) or he stretched himself; or lay, and stretched himself; upon his face, extended upon the ground; as also ↓ تبطّح . (TA.) ―
-b4- It (a valley) became wide; (K, TA;) as also ↓ استبح . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
